auth_method: 'Sign in with Daffy' (protocol not named) or API key as Bearer daffy_production_...
credential_scoping: Not documented; tools 'scoped to your fund'; key 'can move money in your fund'
per_action_or_period_spend_limit: Not documented (only fund balance / 'how much you can donate right now')
confirmation_requirement: Money-moving tools 'annotated as destructive, so clients that honour tool annotations ask you to approve' (https://docs.daffy.org/agents)
confirmation_enforced_where: Client-side (depends on the MCP client honouring annotations); no server-side confirmation documented
sponsor_approval_after_agent_submission: Yes in effect: donations are 'accepted or rejected by Daffy' (API reference https://docs.daffy.org/ref/donations); Daffy says it approves all recommendations (help pages, search-indexed)
cancel_window: Until Daffy accepts or rejects the donation (API reference)
audit_trail: 'anything your assistant does shows up in the Daffy app like any other activity'; keys page shows last-used time (https://docs.daffy.org/auth)
revocation: API key revocable 'at any time'; revoking a Sign-in grant not documented
idempotency: Not documented for API; CLI warns timed-out writes 'may or may not have gone through'
agent_identity_recorded: Not documented (page notes 'you'll usually see the name when it asks for permission')
third_party_wrappers: Third-party Daffy connectors listed by Composio (https://mcp.composio.dev/daffy) and Pipedream (https://pipedream.com/apps/daffy.md); not reviewed
notes: Daffy Gifts not available via MCP

auth_method: Personal API key in X-Api-Key header
credential_scoping: No scopes, read-only keys or expiry documented (https://docs.daffy.org/auth)
sponsor_approval_after_agent_submission: Yes: statuses include approved and rejected; cancel only before 'accepted or rejected by Daffy'
audit_trail: Key list shows fragment and last-used time
agent_identity_recorded: No agent/app field in donation body (amount; ein; note; private_memo)
notes: Statuses: scheduled; waiting_for_funds; approved; rejected; completed; not_completed; check_mailed

minimum_amount: $10 donation, $18 gift; amounts below minimum rejected before request is sent
confirmation_requirement: Prompts [y/N] by default; '--yes' skips the prompt 'only once the member has explicitly confirmed'
confirmation_enforced_where: Client-side CLI prompt; skippable by the agent with --yes; protocol is an instruction to the agent
notes: EIN looked up first so confirmation shows charity name

write_capability: Claimed: 'designed to ... execute real donor requests' (release, 2025-10-27)
money_moving_actions: Release examples: set up monthly recurring $100 grant; contribute 100 shares; add a child to DAF
minimum_amount: $50 minimum grant applies to grants generally (https://intercom.help/give-ria/en/articles/10670838-granting-faqs)
sponsor_approval_after_agent_submission: Grants are reviewed and approved before payment per granting FAQ; sponsor is GiveClear Foundation (repo); Louise's path not documented
cancel_window: Pending grant can be cancelled until approved and processing (granting FAQ)
notes: TIFIN Terms §19 describe the AI Assistant as producing 'insights' that pass a 'compliance check' for investment advice; no clause on executing transactions (https://intercom.help/give-ria/en/articles/10092486-terms-of-use)

interface: REST + OAuth (donor) and partner API key
auth_method: OAuth 2.0 Authorization Code + PKCE; partner API key for server-to-server
credential_scoping: OAuth scopes 'openid accounts transactions profile email address' (+offline_access) (https://docs.endaoment.org/developers/quickstart/login-user.md); not per-action
money_moving_actions: Async grants, entity transfers, donation pledges, fund creation; partner 'Submit settled grant' authorized 'by the tech-platform API key alone'
confirmation_requirement: None documented at API level; separate Recommendation objects let collaborators propose grants for the fund manager
sponsor_approval_after_agent_submission: Yes: 'the Endaoment team will review the grant and perform any required due diligence' (https://docs.endaoment.org/donors/getting-started/recommending-grants.md)
rate_limit: Per source IP at network edge, production only; exceeding triggers ~10-minute ban (https://docs.endaoment.org/developers/quickstart/error-handling.md)
audit_trail: Activity endpoints for fund, caller, org; onchain recordkeeping
idempotency: Required idempotencyKey on donation pledges and grant submissions
notes: Endaoment is itself the sponsor so review happens inside the same organization

credential_scoping: resource:read / resource:write scopes; delegated tokens lose permissions the user's role loses

sponsor_approval_after_agent_submission: n/a (Chariot pays grantmaker-approved disbursements; compliance verification statuses exist)
cancel_window: Cancel until submitted; stop payment afterwards depending on rail
rate_limit: not publicly documented for core API
audit_trail: approved_by / canceled_by / timestamps; events and webhooks
third_party_wrappers: Chariot docs MCP at https://docs.givechariot.com/_mcp/server is for documentation (no account access documented)
notes: Bulk-approve endpoint exists; whether creator and approver must differ is not documented

confirmation_requirement: Donor reviews grant in Chariot pane

agent_identity_recorded: Grant Request IDs used as Idempotency-Key
notes: Shows a sponsor-controlled pattern for third-party grant initiation
